Cascade Machine Works Ltd
Attn: Lease Administration

Subject: Notice of intent to exercise the purchase option, Lease CMW-88-1207

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to give notice, pursuant to clause 8 of the Equipment Lease dated
01 March 2024, of our intention to exercise the purchase option in respect of
the CNC machining centre, serial no. CMW-88-1207.

Please treat the following clause, reproduced from the German counterpart of
the Lease, as controlling in the event of any discrepancy:

    Der Leasingnehmer ist berechtigt, die Maschine nach Ablauf von
    vierundzwanzig (24) Monaten zum Restwert von EUR 96.000,00 zu erwerben.
    Die Ausuebung der Kaufoption bedarf der Schriftform und einer Frist von
    drei (3) Monaten.

We calculate the residual value payable as EUR 96.000,00 and propose a
completion date of 30 September 2024.

Kindly confirm receipt of this notice and advise whether an inspection will be
required before completion.

Yours faithfully,

M. Brenner
Director of Operations
Ridgeline Fabrication GmbH
